BS_ANCIENT_KEYWORD_REPLAY.description: At the start of your turn, if this card is in your [gold]exhaust pile[/gold], play it. Triggers up to [blue]3[/blue] times each combat.
BS_ANCIENT_KEYWORD_REPLAY.title: Replay
BS_ANCIENT_KEYWORD_FORCE_DEATH.descripti: Forced Death cannot be prevented by [gold]Undead[/gold], [gold]Intangible[/gold], or any other effect.
BS_ANCIENT_KEYWORD_FORCE_DEATH.title: Forced Death
BS_ANCIENT_KEYWORD_KILL.description: The total incoming enemy attack damage is greater than or equal to your current HP, Block, Plating, and Osty's current HP combined.
BS_ANCIENT_KEYWORD_KILL.title: Kill
BS_ANCIENT_KEYWORD_ENCORE.description: After you manually play this card this turn, at the start of next turn, automatically play this card a number of times equal to how many times it has been played this combat. Automatic plays count as plays, but do not independently trigger Encore for the next turn.
BS_ANCIENT_KEYWORD_ENCORE.title: Encore
BS_ANCIENT_KEYWORD_KILLING_BLOW.descript: Deal damage with this card and kill an enemy.
BS_ANCIENT_KEYWORD_KILLING_BLOW.title: Killing Blow
BS_ANCIENT_KEYWORD_SAN.description: The shared sanity value for the hand mirror series. It starts at [blue]50[/blue] and is saved across the run. Taking attack damage that causes HP loss reduces SAN by [blue]5[/blue]; multi-hit attacks count each hit separately. Winning combat increases SAN by [blue]20[/blue], up to [blue]80[/blue]. At [blue]100[/blue] or higher SAN, enter [gold]Rationality[/gold]: all enemies gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and [gold]Weak[/gold], and you will not gain Status cards during combat. When leaving Rationality, lose [blue]1[/blue] Energy and gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold]. At [red]-100[/red] or lower SAN, enter low SAN: cards you draw randomly transform for this combat into character cards, Curses, or Statuses; transformed cards are upgraded, and your damage dealt and damage taken are both increased by [green]50%[/green].
BS_ANCIENT_KEYWORD_SAN.title: SAN
